title: Booleans and cutters
summary: How you cut openings: boolean solver, live or applied, how cutters are named, displayed, parented and stored.

request.brief: Model a panel or plate with at least three different openings made the way you make them: a vent grille, a round port and a recessed screw hole or slot. Keep your boolean setup live if that's how you work, and keep your cutters the way you organise them.
must_include: At least 3 openings of different shapes
Your cutters (if you keep them) named, displayed and organised as usual
Any cleanup you do after cutting

questions.ask: What happens to booleans in the end?

options.label: Only for the high poly
options.value: only on the high poly for baking

questions.ask: Do you use a boolean add-on (Bool Tool, HardOps, BoxCutter, other)? Which one?
